title: Two Purchases or One Retry?
description: A customer intentionally buys the same item twice for the same amount, then retries the second purchase after a timeout. How should the API distinguish these actions?

options.text: Treat all identical request bodies as one purchase.
options.explanation: Legitimate separate purchases can have identical bodies. Payload equality alone is not operation identity.

options.text: Generate a new key at the server for every attempt.
options.explanation: A new key makes a retry look like a new operation and permits duplicate effects.

options.text: Use a distinct client key per purchase and reuse the second key on its retry.
options.explanation: Keys identify logical operations. Scope them to the caller and operation, bind the payload, and enforce uniqueness atomically.

options.text: Deduplicate every purchase from that customer for the whole day.
options.explanation: That blocks legitimate activity and still does not bind one key to one intended purchase.
